verdict.rationale: Anthropic's stable Data residency docs describe two separate controls. Workspace geo sets where data is stored at rest and where endpoint processing happens, configured per workspace in the Console. Inference geo sets where model inference runs, per request or as a workspace default, with documented values of "global" and "us". missing for 10: an enumerated list of the storage regions workspace geo offers, inference regions beyond US/global, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Data residency controls let you manage where your data is processed and stored.
Workspace geo: Controls where data is stored at rest and where endpoint processing (such as image transcoding and code execution) occurs. Configured at the workspace level in the Claude Console.
Inference runs only in US-based infrastructure.
